anchoring_rule: after+G4(before-after) at half resolution, no profile/force/guide change, final balanced exchanges fixed
factorial: small forms: point and truncated Gaussian widths0.7/1.5/3; amplitudes3/6/10 times own-plane HH(D); separate positive Y/Co/Cg injections
fine_gain_rules: baseline alpha2 5x5 positive-part; alpha1 5x5; alpha1 3x3; soft E/(E+2sigma^2+1e-12) 5x5. Co/Cg only,6HH,four widths,phases0/3. No change to coarse filtering/profile/Y; report flat noise MSE and retained impulse response
fine_phase_rules: Co/Cg only; amplitude6HH; four centre parities, same noise field/profile; compare I-U(AREA) residual MAD/RMS, G1-band MAD, profile sigma and 5x5 local Wiener energy/gain; phase effects of nonlinear filters also involve a different local noise neighbourhood
limitations: cross target is noisy: loss is NOT clean MSE; debiased risk conditional on equal independent zero-mean noise and stable signal, can be negative; selection uses both frames and can bias conditional risk; reinjection uses centered differential D, loses marginal skew and FPN, not RAW simulation
matched_full_rules: baseline,fine white4to6,full-candidate white4to6/6to8;6/20HH,Co/Cg,4 widths,phase0 only; full reinjection: candidate += q*(original-candidate) before same balanced exchanges; fine branch remains baseline for full variants; oracle detector unchanged; compare peaks,flux,rings and flat noise
matched_rules: baseline, plain matched4to6, whitened matched4to6/6to8;9x9 point/G0.7/1.5/3 zero-DC templates; oracle covariance of local-mean-removed D patches, central65x65 excluded plus4px guard, stride4 cap2048; ridge1% trace/81; h=Creg^-1*g normalized h.g=1; projected calibration MAD; matched maxima not Gaussian PFA; same fine-only reinjection
multiscale_rules: baseline,independent,coarse-to-fine,fine-to-coarse;frozen original undecimated bands x-G1/G1-G2/G2-G4/G4-G8 plus unchanged G8;oracle band MAD of D outside65x65;own=S/(S+N),S=max(E-N,0),energy windows5/7/9/13;gain=own+beta*previousMaxOwn*(1-own),beta0/.5;freeze each contribution, no recycled filtered input;same P support/Y/balanced exchanges;6/20HH phase0;not BM3D or probability
